title: Testing in Python — From Zero to Confident
prereqs: Comfortable reading & writing basic Python (functions, classes, imports)
pip install pytest pytest-cov hypothesis pytest-asyncio httpx fastapi
description: Learn to test Python code from absolute zero — what a test even is — and ramp to the depth a senior engineer is expected to have. Covers the pytest model end to end: assertions, fixtures and dependency injection, parametrization and markers, mocking and test doubles (and when NOT to mock), test-driven development, coverage as a tool (not a goal), property-based testing with Hypothesis, async tests, and testing real systems — APIs, databases, and pytest in CI. Every challenge grades the one thing that matters: can your tests pass on correct code AND catch the bugs? Verifiers mutate the code behind your back and your suite has to notice.
